game.title: Batman: Arkham Knight
game.blurb: Open-world action-adventure in which Batman takes on Scarecrow, the militia and the Arkham Knight across Gotham City, from Rocksteady Studios, released 2015-06-23. RAWG average playtime: 19 hours. Genre: Action. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Batman against Scarecrow, the militia and the Arkham Knight. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Most Wanted and City Crimes
chapters.summary: Weapons caches, watchtowers, checkpoints, explosive ordnance, APCs, bank heists, rescues and supervillains locked up in GCPD.

chapters.title: Riddler Trials
chapters.summary: The Riddler's trials and the keys they unlock.

chapters.title: Combat, Gliding and the Batmobile
chapters.summary: FreeFlow combat, predator and fear takedowns, gliding feats, and Batmobile driving and tank battles.

chapters.title: Story Packs and Extra Missions (DLC)
chapters.summary: A block of mostly hidden add-on story achievements, plus Penguin's escape, the Riddler's hideout and Two-Face at Hell's Gate. Placed by list position.

chapters.title: Extra Villain Missions (DLC)
chapters.summary: Later missions: an assassin's trail and the Lazarus pit, Mad Hatter's hostages, a missing cryopod and Killer Croc's prisoners.

chapters.title: AR Challenges
chapters.summary: Star targets in AR Challenges for each Batmobile and each playable character, and the special challenge maps.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 208650)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Knight
Fandom (batman.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://batman.fandom.com/wiki/Batman:_Arkham_Knight
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a guide at completion stage 1, but only the first three walkthrough pages are written ("Prologue", about 1,400 characters; "Saving Poison Ivy", about 1,900; "Working Around Gotham City", about 2,500) out of about 30 listed story, side-mission and add-on pages; Gameplay, Controls and a long Achievements and trophies page (about 21,000 characters) also exist. That is too little for a real guide, so it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. Its contents page lists add-on pages "A Flip of a Coin", "Batgirl: A Matter of Family", "Catwoman's Revenge", "GCPD Lockdown", "Harley Quinn Story Pack" and "Red Hood Story Pack". batman.fandom.com answers the API under "Batman: Arkham Knight", with about 105 linked pages, including "Gotham's Most Wanted"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives no game name; the store list confirms app 208650. 30 of 113 Steam achievements are hidden. The ten hidden ones at 70 to 79 plus "Rough Justice", "The Cat Came Back" and "Succession Plans" were grouped as add-on story content by schema position; which pack each belongs to is not in the data. Achievements 94 to 105 (assassins, Mad Hatter, the cryopod, Killer Croc) were given their own add-on chapter by position. "City of Fear", "Judgment Day" and "With a Vengeance!" were put in the main story; they may be Most Wanted missions. "The Curtain Falls" (Monarch Theatre) sits in the AR Challenge block and was placed there by name. The other 20 hidden ones sit in the main story chapter.
